name: synthetic-prospects-search-unresolved
description: A filter search naming a company nothing matches: 422 FILTER_VALUE_UNRESOLVED, with `param` naming the filter and `values` the names that matched nothing. Nothing was charged. Synthetic, shaped on Fuse's published Business API contract (2026-10-29).

error.message: No company, place or LinkedIn profile named in one filter could be found, so the search was refused rather than run without it.
